messages:
emma.presales: Starting Medibridge POC thread. They want an SSE stream with incremental patient summaries + function calls to pull patient records from their EHR. PHI rules: must use customer-managed keys and SAML SSO. Can we deliver a 48h demo kit?

dan.sales: Procurement question: if they need Dedicated for KMS, do we have a 3-month trial price or only monthly reserved? Also need an engineer-accessible demo for their security team.

pavan.se: Hosted VPC might be acceptable for an internal non-prod sandbox, but for PHI we recommend Dedicated or Private. We'll need to confirm whether KMS must be entirely on-prem or if cloud KMS with BYOK is ok.

nina.eng: For streaming, SSE is easiest to integrate. We suggest chunked JSON objects like:

```
{ "event": "delta", "patient": "p-42", "section": "labs", "partial": true, "payload": {"text":"hgb 13.2"} }
```

This allows client to append sections as they arrive.

chao.sdk: SDK tips: current stable JS SDK supports streaming + function-calls. Example snippet:

```js
await client.stream({ model: 'redwood-pro-1', input: prompt, structured_output: true, onChunk: (chunk) => console.log(chunk) })
```

I'll add a small Node demo that wires a function-call to a fake /ehr endpoint.

emma.presales: Two action items for the 48h deliverable: 1) minimal demo repo with SSE+function-call wired to a mocked EHR, 2) concise security answers (KMS, audit logs, SSO) for their questionnaire. Can we do that?

pavan.se: I can draft the security answers. Quick facts to include: audit logs for key usage are available in Console; retention depends on plan but can be exported; SOC2 report available on request. Will confirm KMS rotation and exportability.

dan.sales: Pricing follow-up: please provide a quick ballpark for Dedicated with ~2x A100 equivalent (for parallel streams). Procurement asked for a rough monthly number to move forward.

nina.eng: I'll ping finance but put a placeholder: Dedicated baseline + node hours ~ (ballpark) 3-4x hosted per-CPU-token cost. Will confirm exact.

emma.presales: POC acceptance criteria proposal: 1) stream shows incremental patient summary updated in UI within 300-600ms per chunk under light load, 2) function-call returns structured patient JSON matching agreed schema, 3) key usage appears in audit logs, 4) SAML login via their IdP works. If all pass, we hand to onboarding.

chao.sdk: I'll draft the schema: [patient_id, section, severity, confidence, text]. Will add example responses to the demo README.

secbot: Security note: on-prem KMS required -> customer-managed key material. Console supports audit export (CSV/JSON). Flagged for security review.

emma.presales: Timeline: Day 0: demo repo + README, Day 1: internal run-through, Day 2: customer demo + security pack + rough quote. Dan to confirm calendar.

dan.sales: Calendar invite sent for Day 2 demo.

pavan.se: I'll open a short runbook with handshake details (auth header, SSE endpoint, function-call contract) and paste link here when ready. :white_check_mark:

emma.presales: Great work team — call out any blockers here.
